host.title: Local IP of Daikin Air Purifier
host.description: Optional when your Daikin account is set below: status is then read from the Daikin cloud, and this IP is the fallback. Required for read-only use without an account.

cacheDuration.title: Cache Duration (seconds)
cacheDuration.description: How often status is fetched. Minimum 15 seconds from the local IP, 60 from the Daikin cloud. Each refresh is one request; refreshing too often can get your Daikin account rate-limited (the plugin then pauses cloud requests for 5 minutes).

username.title: Daikin Account Email
username.description: Required for control and cloud status. The email you sign in to the Daikin Smart App with. Leave the whole section empty to read status from the local IP only.

password.title: Daikin Account Password
password.description: Required for control and cloud status. Your Daikin Smart App password.

clientSecret.title: Client Secret
clientSecret.description: Required for control and cloud status. The client_secret in the body of the Daikin Smart App's https://prod-dsioti.daikinsmartdb.jp/dsioti/oauth2/token request, captured once.

terminalId.title: Terminal ID
terminalId.description: Required for control only (cloud status works without it). The terminalid query parameter of the Daikin Smart App's https://api.daikinsmartdb.jp/cleaner/set_control_info request, captured once.

port.title: Port
port.description: Optional. Leave empty to read it from the purifier (port= at http://<purifier IP>/common/basic_info), or 30050 when there's no local IP.

clientId.title: Client ID (advanced)
clientId.description: Leave empty to use the Daikin Smart App's client ID.

uuid.title: App UUID (advanced)
uuid.description: Leave empty to have the plugin generate one.

code.title: Authorization Code (advanced)
code.description: Alternative to email and password, used with the Client Secret: a code captured from the Daikin Smart App. It works a single time, and may not work without the app's PKCE code verifier.

refreshToken.title: Refresh Token (advanced)
refreshToken.description: Alternative to email and password: a refresh_token captured from the Daikin Smart App.

layout.title: Daikin cloud (status and control from HomeKit)
layout.description: Email, Password and Client Secret read status from the Daikin cloud; add Terminal ID to also control the purifier. Leave them all empty to use the local IP only.
